note: Main sidebar chrome -- renders: user status indicator, fixed navigation icon buttons (Home, Messages, etc.), and user profile link; the rooms-list is subtracted as it contains user-created channel and DM names
Sidebar top bar -- renders: fixed section title (e.g. 'Omnichannel') and fixed action buttons (refresh, settings)
Sidebar section headers -- renders: fixed category labels (e.g. 'Channels', 'Direct Messages')
Sidebar footer -- renders: platform logo and version string
User profile footer -- renders: current user's display name and status, which are self-authored by the operator of the session
Main content area -- renders: platform-authored onboarding headings, descriptions, and action buttons (e.g. 'Get Started', 'Invite People')
